data.name: Carved in Stone: Arena
data.detailed_description:
Top-down PvP arena combat

Pick your class, queue your format, earn your rating.

Rated arena combat

Solo or team formats tracked by a true Glicko-2 rating system. Climb the ladder. Settle the argument.

3D rendered as pixel art

Modern lighting and effects wrapped in the classic isometric silhouette — the look that built the genre, without its limitations.

---

Join the Playtest

In active development. Request access to test, shape the game, and talk directly with the dev team. Expect rough edges and rapid iteration.

data.short_description: An arena based competitive PvP game. MMO/MOBA style combat. 3d pixel art (How does that make sense?). Let me emphasize, COMPETITIVE PVP GAME. Stay hydrated, because this game is sweaty AF.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 (2 GB VRAM, Vulkan 1.1 or D3D12 support)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectSound compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectSound compatible

content_descriptors.notes:
Hey, this is a competitive PvP game. The depictions of combat, aren't particularly graphic. It's a 3d pixel game. There is blood.

The thing to consider more, is that, this is a competitive pvp game... with other players. While we have moderation measures in place, any online game, contains mature content because interaction with other individuals, is in fact mature content.
